name: Port Checker
author: Widgeter
description: Shows which TCP ports on localhost or another host are open, with connect latency; checks common dev ports by default.

config.label: Ports (one per line)
config.default:
3000 React / Node
5173 Vite
4200 Angular
8080 HTTP alt
8000 Django
5432 PostgreSQL
3306 MySQL
27017 MongoDB
6379 Redis
11211 Memcached
config.help: Format: port label, or host:port label to check another machine. Lines starting with # are ignored.

config.label: Default host
config.help: Used for lines that do not give their own host.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.help: Closed local ports answer instantly; raise this for remote hosts.
